🎥🎬: Chewing Gum (2015)

Tracey Gordon is a 24-year-old woman raised in a strict religious household who is ready to discover what life has to offer beyond the rules she has always followed. Obsessed with Beyoncé and inexperienced in many aspects of adulthood, Tracey is determined to explore her desires, find love, and finally figure out who she really is.

Living on a London housing estate with her family and friends, Tracey finds herself caught between her religious upbringing and her curiosity about the outside world. Her relationship with her devout fiancé, Ronald, becomes complicated when she develops feelings for Connor, a charming local poet. As she tries to navigate romance, friendship, work, and independence, her attempts to become more worldly lead to one outrageous situation after another.

Unfiltered, awkward, and hilariously unpredictable, Chewing Gum follows a young woman stumbling through adulthood on her own terms, proving that growing up doesn’t always mean knowing what you’re doing.
